description: Project-owned compatibility declaration (NOT a Claude Code manifest extension). Per-skill snapshots under skills/<name>/references/runtime-compatibility.json are GENERATED from this file by tools/sync_skill_runtime_docs.py — never edit the copies.

cli_not_required_for: explaining source or behavior the user already provided
sap-adt-cli.notes: Without the CLI this skill can only guide installation/configuration; it must never fake an online result.

cli_required_for: online TR collection via `sap-adt transport collect`
sap-transport-gate.notes: A missing CLI degrades to offline modes with an explicit declaration; collection results are never fabricated.

abap-code-review.notes: No online fetch path is defined for this skill; it must not demand a CLI install.

sap-integration-wiki.notes: Pure knowledge base; never checks for or installs a CLI.
